title: Notice of appeal against conviction
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Criminal Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every statutory provision cited.

parts.why: The appeal lies to the Court of Appeal; name its division. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
APPEAL NO: ............
CHARGE NO: {{chargeNumber}}
BETWEEN:
{{appellant}} .................... APPELLANT
AND
{{respondent}} .................... RESPONDENT
parts.why: The appeal number is left for the Registry; the charge number from the trial. The convicted defendant is the appellant. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: To the Registrar of the High Court, {{trialCourt}}:
parts.why: The notice is filed in the registry of the court below. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
NOTICE OF APPEAL

I, {{appellant}}, having been convicted of the offence of {{offence}} by the {{trialCourt}}, presided over by {{trialJudge}}, on {{judgmentDate}}, and sentenced to {{sentence}}, and now being in custody at {{custodyPlace}}, do hereby give notice of appeal against my conviction on the following grounds:
parts.why: States the conviction appealed against: the offence, the court and judge, the date and the sentence. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.instruction: Write the grounds of appeal from the facts given, each headed 'GROUND 1', 'GROUND 2' and so on: each ground states an error of law or fact by the trial court in one sentence, followed by 'PARTICULARS:' setting out the particulars of that error. End with the omnibus ground that the judgment is unreasonable and cannot be supported having regard to the evidence. Do not argue the grounds.
parts.why: The grounds of appeal, each with its particulars, ending with the omnibus ground. Grounds state the errors; they do not argue them. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
parts.heading: GROUNDS OF APPEAL

parts.text:
........................................
Signature or mark of the Appellant or his counsel

Dated this ............ day of ............ 20.....
parts.why: The appellant or counsel signs and dates the notice. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The particulars of the trial and conviction at the foot of the notice. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Court of Appeal division
fields.question: Which Court of Appeal division? For example: Lagos.

fields.label: Charge number at the trial
fields.question: The charge number at the trial, if known.

fields.label: Respondent
fields.question: Who prosecuted? For example: The State of Lagos.

fields.label: Trial court
fields.question: Which court convicted? For example: High Court of Lagos State, Ikeja.

fields.label: Trial judge
fields.question: Who presided? For example: Hon. Justice A. B. Ojo.

fields.label: Offence
fields.question: Of what offence was the appellant convicted?

fields.label: Place of custody
fields.question: Where is the appellant held? For example: Kirikiri Custodial Centre, Lagos.
